role: @Observable @MainActor view model behind MorningResultsView (the Recovery Report sheet): resolves the displayed session (input or re-analysed/archived copy), computes the frozen-or-live composite recovery score and its breakdown, generates and memoises the narrative summary, loads sleep (frozen snapshot or live HealthKit/estimate) and persists the perceived-readiness answer for unreliable nights.
types: MorningResultsViewModel: class (@Observable, @MainActor, final) — presentation state + scoring/sleep loading for MorningResultsView
state: mem:MorningResultsViewModel.onUpdateSleep (closure set by view to collector.updateSessionSleepBoundaries)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: isReanalyzing/isGeneratingPDF/isGeneratingEmailPDF=false, isSleepLoading=true, summaryMemo=nil, archiveUpdateGeneration=0, liveSleepWaitNanoseconds=60 s. init default arguments read AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager and AppDependencies.current.collection.healthKitManager. No conformances beyond @Observable macro synthesis.

units.does: Returns reanalyzedSession when set, else the immutable input session; the session every score/summary reads.

branches.effect: re-analysed or archive-adopted copy when present; the original input session otherwise

units.does: Computed: the week of nights before displaySession from the sleep archived with recentSessions (SleepTrendStats.recentNights); nil when none has measured sleep. Read by the summary generator input, its memo key and the PDF report inputs.
Returns displaySession.analysisResult, falling back to the input result.

branches.effect: the session's own analysis when present; the init-time result when the session carries none

units.does: True when displaySession has an RR series with at least one point; gates reanalysis, charts and deep-dive sections in the view.

branches.effect: nil series (e.g. stripped lightweight session) → false; else → !points.isEmpty

units.does: Returns the input session's endDate, or its startDate when endDate is nil; the date historical checks anchor on.

branches.effect: endDate for completed sessions; startDate when the session has no endDate

units.does: True when sessionReferenceDate is not in today's calendar day (Calendar.current).
For today's session returns TrainingLoadRegistry.live() (the live training-load snapshot); nil for historical sessions so advice reads the frozen load.

branches.effect: true → nil (frozen load used downstream); false → TrainingLoadRegistry.live()

units.does: Maps the live load (today) or the frozen trainingSnapshot/analysis trainingContext into TrainingAdviceGate.LoadLevel, used for the score-card breakdown message.

branches.effect: frozen training snapshot when stored; analysis-time training context otherwise (both may be nil → preferring decides)

units.does: Copies displaySession, sets perceivedReadiness (nil clears it), re-scores it (applyPerceivedReadinessScore), assigns it to reanalyzedSession so the UI updates, and persists the rating — nil included — through persistPerceivedReadiness, which reverts the screen to the previous session if the write fails.
units.entry: SubjectiveReadinessCard binding setter in MorningResultsView.subjectiveReadinessSection and unreadableFallbackCard

units.does: For an unreliable-HRV night with baseline loaded, recomputes the breakdown via calculateWithBreakdown(useBaselineHRV: true, perceivedReadiness, ansBalance, referenceDate = session date) from the session's frozen sleep snapshot only (the same sleep input ReanalysisService.rescoreBreakdown uses), and writes recoveryScore (0-10), scoreBreakdown and frozenReadiness onto the inout session.

branches.cond: guard night is NOT reliable for HRV aggregates AND baselineStats loaded
branches.effect: reliable night or no baseline → session left unchanged (rating stored without re-score); else re-score
session's analysis, else init result
frozen training snapshot, else analysis context
reference date for staleness = end date, else start date

units.does: Main-actor Task: reads the archived copy off main (loadArchived), applies the rating to it and re-scores it from its own inputs (falls back to the in-memory scored copy when the session is not archived), then off main writes only the rating and score fields (writePerceivedReadiness: SessionArchive.update under the archive lock, or a whole archive when not archived). If the user has not changed the rating meanwhile, a successful write adopts the written copy for display and a failed read or write restores the session shown before the change.

branches.effect: archived copy when present (its inputs are re-scored); the in-memory scored copy when the session is not archived (or could not be read)
no write attempted; saved = false

branches.cond: reanalyzedSession's rating no longer equals value (a newer edit)
branches.effect: leaves the screen alone
adopts the written copy (rating, score, snapshots); else reverts reanalyzedSession to the pre-change session

units.does: Nonisolated: retrieves the session from the shared archive; returns (session or nil when not archived, readable = true), or (nil, false) after a warning log when retrieve throws.

branches.effect: logs at warning level and returns (nil, false)

units.does: Nonisolated: writes the rating and score fields via storePerceivedReadiness (in place on an archived copy, whole session otherwise), logs the outcome, and returns false when the write threw.

branches.cond: storePerceivedReadiness throws (e.g. fileNotFound after a delete)
branches.effect: warning log, returns false

units.does: Nonisolated, throws: for an archived session, SessionArchive.update(id) sets perceivedReadiness, recoveryScore, scoreBreakdown and frozenReadiness from the re-scored copy under one archive lock (other fields keep the archive's newest values; stamps modifiedAt and requests re-upload); for an unarchived one, archives the copy (skipSameNightMerge: false, requestingReupload: true).

branches.effect: false: archive the whole copy and return; true: in-place update of the four fields

units.does: Returns settingsManager.settings (current UserSettings).
Builds a RecoveryScoreCalculator.ScoringConfiguration from the current settings.
Displayed 0-100 recovery score: the frozen displaySession.recoveryScore ×10 passed through ScoreVerdict.clampedDisplayScore (NaN-safe), else the live computed score.

branches.effect: frozen → clamped frozen×10; nil (pre-acceptance) → liveRecoveryScore

units.does: Live composite from calculateWithBreakdown(trainingContext:…, referenceDate: sessionReferenceDate) using displayResult HRV metrics, baselineStats, healthKitSleep, recoveryVitals, typicalSleepHours, scoringConfig and the ANS-balance term, clamped to a finite 0-100 by ScoreVerdict.clampedDisplayScore. The staleness penalty is measured at the session's own date, not today.

branches.effect: frozen training snapshot, else analysis context (ignored by the composite)

units.does: Returns pnsIndex − snsIndex from displayResult.ansMetrics, or nil when either is missing.

branches.cond: guard both pnsIndex and snsIndex present
branches.effect: either missing → nil; else pns − sns

units.does: Returns the stored displaySession.scoreBreakdown, else a live breakdown pinned to the frozen score.

branches.effect: stored → returned as-is; nil → pinnedToFrozenScore(liveBreakdown())

units.does: Computes a breakdown with calculateWithBreakdown(trainingContext:) preferring frozen sleep/vitals/training snapshots over the live-loaded sleep/vitals; referenceDate is the session's own date (sessionReferenceDate).

branches.effect: frozen training, else analysis context
frozen sleep, else loaded sleep
frozen vitals, else loaded vitals

units.does: If a frozen score exists and the live composite differs from frozen×10 by more than 1 point, returns a new ScoreBreakdown with compositeScore = frozen×10, the live tier/factors/penalties/spo2 flag and scoringVersion 'unversioned' (the frozen composite has no recorded algorithm); else returns the live breakdown unchanged.

branches.effect: no frozen score → live breakdown
within 1 point → live breakdown; else pinned copy labelled unversioned (factors no longer add up to the composite)

units.does: Returns the narrative AnalysisSummary, regenerated only when summaryKey changes; on regeneration stores the memo and publishes the summary to the Assistant's AnalysisSummaryCache keyed by session id + fingerprint.

branches.effect: cache hit → memo summary returned, no side effects; miss → generate, memoise, push to AnalysisSummaryCache

units.does: Hashes the session fingerprint, narrative language flag, app locale, selected tags, every sleep field the generator reads (combineSleepInputs), two sleep-trend fields, two baseline fields, the live readiness score/TRIMP and the live training load (combineLiveLoad(adviceLiveLoad)) into an Int memo key. recentSessions is an immutable input and is not hashed.

Feeds the hasher the AnalysisSleepInput built from healthKitSleep (total, in-bed, deep, REM, awake minutes and measured efficiency — what the generator reads) plus sleepTrendStats average minutes and nights analysed.
Feeds the hasher the live load's ATL, CTL, TSB, ACWR, today's TRIMP, monotony and strain (all nil for a past night).

Builds an AnalysisSummaryGenerator from displayResult/displaySession, recentSessions, selectedTags, sleep and sleep-trend inputs, training context, age/sex settings, live readiness/TRIMP, the live load and the canonical baseline (exp(lnRmssdMean), meanHRBaseline).

branches.effect: frozen training, else analysis context
today's TRIMP from live readiness; 0 when not today's overnight session

units.does: For today's overnight session computes LiveReadiness from the composite score, the session and the shared TrainingMetricsCache.current; nil otherwise.

branches.effect: other type or past night → nil (morning steps stand); else live readiness

units.does: Stores inputs and services, seeds selectedTags from session.tags, notes from session.notes, selectedMethod from settings.defaultWindowSelectionMethod, then seeds sleep/vitals from frozen snapshots synchronously.
units.entry: Constructed by MorningResultsView.init as @State wrappedValue (MorningResultsView.swift:157); also by tests SleepRefreshPolicyTests.swift:333 and UncoveredScreenSnapshotTests.swift:209

branches.effect: stored notes, else empty string

branches.effect: seed sleep + loading=false; absent → stays nil/loading
seed vitals; absent → nil

units.does: View .task entry: live sleep fetch only when displaySession has no frozen sleep snapshot; otherwise just clears the loading flag.

branches.effect: no snapshot → fetchHealthKitSleep(); snapshot → isSleepLoading=false

units.entry: Also called from MorningResultsView.refetchSleepIfNotAdjusted on morningCoordination fetch completion / sleepDataVersion change (MorningResultsView.swift:593)

branches.effect: other types → log, loading=false, return
adopt snapshot, loading=false, return (refetch becomes a no-op once frozen)
unavailable → log, loading=false, return; available → live load

units.does: Returns HRVSession.sleepFetchWindow for the input session using recentSessions, the user's sleepSchedule and effectiveMergeGapSeconds.

Fetches HealthKit sleep for the computed window (with the session's RR points), resolves zero-sleep via estimate fallback, assigns healthKitSleep, clears loading and hands measured sleep to onUpdateSleep; when today's night has nothing yet it starts the 60 s spinner timeout; errors clear loading.

branches.effect: nil (today, 0 sleep, no estimate) → endSleepLoadingAfterWait (spinner for up to 60 s, then '--'; a later refetch still fills the card) and return; else assign and store boundaries
debug-logged, isSleepLoading=false, healthKitSleep stays nil

branches.cond: view model deallocated or healthKitSleep set during the wait
branches.effect: returns without touching isSleepLoading

branches.effect: any false → nothing; all true → onUpdateSleep?(sleep) (no-op when closure nil)

branches.effect: return RR estimate; else fall through

branches.cond: guard self alive AND a changed copy came back AND this request is still the latest generation
branches.effect: otherwise returns (unchanged, unreadable, gone, or superseded by a later bump)
